title: Wayfinder — Metro Map Studio
description: Draw octolinear transit maps: segments snap to 45°, shared trunks run parallel, interchanges build themselves.
concept: A drafting table for the diagrammatic transit map. Drop stations and Wayfinder routes every segment octolinearly with at most one 45° bend; when two lines share a leg they automatically fan out into parallel trunk tracks, and any stop touched by more than one line becomes a double-ringed interchange. Rename stops, re-place labels by hand or let the auto-placer find the compass slot furthest from the tracks, then export the finished diagram as print-ready SVG, a 2× PNG, or JSON.
features: Three tools — draw, move/select, erase — with octolinear routing and grid snapping
Unlimited colour-coded lines; shared segments render as parallel trunk tracks
Automatic interchange rings wherever two or more lines meet a stop
Station inspector: rename, 8-way label placement, plus a one-click auto-placer
Three themes (Paper, Midnight, Blueprint) and two bend styles
Three starter networks and a 60-step undo/redo history
Export to SVG, 2× PNG and JSON; share any map as a URL hash; autosaves to localStorage

interaction.mouse: Hover previews the next segment; wheel zooms around the cursor; shift-drag or drag empty space pans.
interaction.click: Draw tool drops a stop — click an existing stop to turn it into an interchange. Double-click any stop to rename it.
interaction.touch: Tap to place stops, drag to move them, pinch to zoom; the control panel slides up as a bottom sheet.
interaction.keyboard: 1/2/3 switch tools · N new line · L auto-place labels · F fit · G grid · Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z undo and redo.
